{{Quote|I am Nandina, recently released from a banishment chamber with my pet here, Gorvo.|Azzenaj|<ref name="The Nightsister's Revenge">{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|scenario=Singing Mountain Assault and Nightsister Roundup promotional scenarios}}</ref>}}
'''Nandina''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] clan of the [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri Witches]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was imprisoned in the [[Chamber of Banishment]]; however, at some point she escaped along with her pet [[Rancor/Legends|rancor]] [[Gorvo]]. She hungered for revenge against the [[Singing Mountain Clan]] and especially against its Arch Witch, [[Azzenaj]]. She began informing the occasional encounters of her intentions, and soon a spacer came to her looking to perform the job. Nandina instructed him to go to the Singing Mountain village and kill Azzenaj, promising him a rich reward for killing the witch she long hated. The next day, the spacer returned and presented a piece of Azzenaj's jewelry as the proof of the job done.

==Behind the scenes==
Nandina was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:AM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Nandina was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Axkva Min|"Axkva Min" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:AM" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|"Chapter 7" update]], on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref>
